description: This file contains unit tests for the StateMachineManager component in the Orleans' journaling infrastructure. It verifies registration, recovery, concurrency, and large state handling of durable state machines such as dictionaries, lists, and individual values within a grain, using the Xunit testing framework.

classes.name: StateMachineManagerTests
classes.description: A set of unit tests for the StateMachineManager component, ensuring correct registration, persistence, recovery, concurrency, and large data handling.

methods.name: StateMachineManager_RegisterStateMachine_Test
methods.description: Tests the registration and basic operation of multiple state machines, verifying data persistence.

methods.name: StateMachineManager_StateRecovery_Test
methods.description: Tests recovery of multiple state machines after persisting their state.

methods.name: StateMachineManager_MultipleWriteStates_Test
methods.description: Verifies multiple write operations and the consistency of final state recovery.

methods.name: StateMachineManager_MultipleStateMachines_Test
methods.description: Checks handling of multiple state machines of different types in a single grain.

methods.name: StateMachineManager_Concurrency_Test
methods.description: Ensures namespace isolation and correct operation under concurrent modifications.

methods.name: StateMachineManager_LargeStateRecovery_Test
methods.description: Stress test for recovering large state dictionaries with thousands of entries.
